$comment: Seeded into ~/.claude/settings.json on a container's first start, and never
touched again — edit the file in the volume, not this one.
The plugins here are the ones that pay for themselves on a bot that runs a
CLI on every message: rtk and context-mode cut what a tool call costs,
caveman and ponytail cut what a reply costs, superpowers supplies the
The two hooks are the ones that would otherwise be discovered the hard way:
rtk compresses Bash output before it reaches the model, and image-downscale
hands Read a 1024px copy of a photo instead of the original — measured at
93 MB -> 267 KB on a real folder, and an image stays in the transcript, so
every later turn pays for it again.
